_: What this repo needs on the machine. Read by lib/doctor.js (steward doctor) and printed into docs/prereqs.md (steward doctor --markdown; a test keeps them equal). Plain JSON, not TOML, because reading TOML needs yq, which is itself on this list. need: required | optional. source: system (comes with the OS, or the Xcode tools on macOS) | mise (a tool in mise/config.toml; `mise` is its name there) | brew (Homebrew formula) | manual. check overrides the default `command -v <bin>`; version is a command whose first line is shown. platforms (parity 0.6, D69): where it applies (macos, linux), every platform when absent. need, source and install may be a table keyed by family (debian, rhel, suse …) or platform (macos, linux); a family wins over its platform. An install that starts with sudo is always a step by hand: the doctor never runs sudo (D-b). where: false hides the path of bin, for an entry whose bin only runs its check.

areas.fleet: steward fleet …, steward review, the pr-consolidation scripts
areas.dev: Working on this repo: lint, docs checks, Renovate config checks

prereqs.name: macOS
prereqs.why: Its audit of Homebrew casks, the App Store, macOS updates and the macOS trust stores

prereqs.name: Linux
prereqs.why: os-release names the distribution and its family, which pick the package sources, paths and install hints (D63)

prereqs.name: bash
prereqs.why: Every supply-chain script. The macOS 3.2 is enough and is what they are written for

prereqs.name: git
prereqs.why: Project discovery, onboarding, sync, prune and every PR step

prereqs.name: curl
prereqs.why: Registry, Homebrew and advisory lookups

prereqs.name: mise
prereqs.why: Installs and pins every tool below; `steward sc` wraps it. The standalone build in ~/.local/bin; `steward sc upgrade-tool mise` updates it (D38)

prereqs.name: node
prereqs.why: lib/*.js, drift, onboarding, review, doctor and the tests

prereqs.name: libatomic
prereqs.why: Node 26's Linux builds (x64 and arm64) link libatomic.so.1, which minimal installs leave out

prereqs.name: just
prereqs.why: Developer tasks only: `just test`, `lint`, `docs`, `links`, `release-worktree`. The steward itself runs as `steward`

prereqs.name: yq
prereqs.why: Reads steward.toml and the policy files (`yq -p toml`)

prereqs.name: Homebrew
prereqs.why: `steward sc audit` and `steward sc upgrade` manage formulae and casks (formulae only on Linux, as Linuxbrew)

prereqs.name: npm
prereqs.why: Installs the npm -g hybrids (Ruflo, AgentDB) with a reviewed script allow-list

prereqs.name: shasum
prereqs.why: `steward sc node-patch` checks the Node tarball against SHASUMS256

prereqs.name: sha256sum
prereqs.why: `steward sc node-patch` checks the Node tarball against SHASUMS256 (in place of shasum)

prereqs.name: security
prereqs.why: `steward sc audit` reads the macOS system roots and admin trust settings

prereqs.name: softwareupdate
prereqs.why: `steward sc audit` lists pending macOS updates

prereqs.name: mas
prereqs.why: `steward sc audit` checks the App Store; skipped with a warning when missing

prereqs.name: Docker
prereqs.why: `steward sc audit` checks running images and IOC digests; skipped when Docker is not running

prereqs.name: gh
prereqs.why: Every PR, review, issue and alert read; `steward review` and `steward fleet prune-merged`

prereqs.name: gh login
prereqs.why: GitHub is the source of record for alerts and updates; the weekly review and prune-merged need a logged-in gh

prereqs.name: jq
prereqs.why: The pr-consolidation scripts (lock-age, pr-status, merge-and-close …) and the release check parse gh and registry JSON

prereqs.name: shellcheck
prereqs.why: `just lint` and the lock-age script check

prereqs.name: markdownlint-cli2
prereqs.why: `just docs` Markdown lint

prereqs.name: lychee
prereqs.why: `just docs` and `just links` link checks

prereqs.name: renovate
prereqs.why: Checking a renovate.json with `renovate --platform=local`
